mapper.select: select #{providerCode} as providerCode, count(1) as totalCount, coalesce(sum(case when recent.status = 'success' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successCount, coalesce(sum(case when recent.status = 'failed' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failedCount, case when count(1) = 0 then 0 else round(coalesce(sum(case when recent.status = 'success' then 1 else 0 end), 0) * 100 / count(1), 2) end as successRate, coalesce(round(avg(recent.duration_ms)), 0) as avgDurationMs, ( select last_log.status from ai_image_provider_call_log last_log where last_log.provider_code = #{providerCode} order by last_log.log_id desc limit 1 ) as lastStatus, ( select last_log.error_message from ai_image_provider_call_log last_log where last_log.provider_code = #{providerCode} order by last_log.log_id desc limit 1 ) as lastErrorMessage, ( select last_log.create_time from ai_image_provider_call_log last_log where last_log.provider_code = #{providerCode} order by last_log.log_id desc limit 1 ) as lastCallTime, ( select count(1) from ai_image_provider_call_log fail_log where fail_log.provider_code = #{providerCode} and fail_log.status = 'failed' and fail_log.log_id > coalesce(( select max(success_log.log_id) from ai_image_provider_call_log success_log where success_log.provider_code = #{providerCode} and success_log.status = 'success' ), 0) ) as consecutiveFailures from ( select status, duration_ms from ai_image_provider_call_log where provider_code = #{providerCode} order by log_id desc limit #{limit} ) recent

select count(1) from ai_image_provider_call_log fail_log where fail_log.provider_code = #{providerCode} and fail_log.status = 'failed' and fail_log.create_time >= date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{minutes} minute) and fail_log.log_id > coalesce(( select max(success_log.log_id) from ai_image_provider_call_log success_log where success_log.provider_code = #{providerCode} and success_log.status = 'success' ), 0)
